0022600187.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-5, 3rd in the Pacific and 12th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (2-5, 5th in the Southeast and 12th in the East) in the Suns' seventh game of the season, with Phoenix on a four-game losing streak and 1-2 at home while Orlando has lost two straight and is 0-4 at home. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with shoulder surgery, and Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Suns' last meeting a 115-111 loss in Orlando on March 31, 2026, and they have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
